# Chrome Session Viewer
# https://lachlanallison.github.io/chrome-session-viewer/

> Web app that parses Google Chrome session files entirely in the browser. Extract and view tabs, groups, and history; export data. No uploads — session files never leave your device.

## App
- /

## Features
- Drop or browse for Chrome session files
- View URLs, titles, tab groups, and history
- Export extracted tab data
- Client-side processing only

- Built by Lachlan Allison: https://lachlanallison.com/
